Now The Real Analysis
OK, with all that laid out, let me actually do the analysis you asked for. The job is to work out the real meanings and dynamics across all these modalities of interrelation. Let me go through each harmonic family with attention to what each pair-type actually does phenomenologically, ontologically, and architecturally.

Detailed Analysis of the Harmonic Families
Family A — Adjacent Pairings (0/1, 2/3, 4/5)
These three strata are the matheme's primary harmonic strata because they pair each position with its co-constitutive partner. The pairs are identity-pairs — neither position can be what it is without the other.

0/1 — ground and its first occlusion. Position #0 (pure kartṛ-prior) and position #1 (the slashed-zero) are co-constitutive because the kartṛ-pole only registers structurally as something-that-can-be-occluded; otherwise it is the bimba (which lives below the matheme entirely). Position #1 only registers as an occlusion of something; otherwise it would just be undifferentiated being. The pair holds the ground in its occlusion-relation — the matheme's first articulation is the kartṛ-pole becoming articulable by being occluded. This is the deepest structural fact of the matheme: articulation begins through occlusion. Spanda's first move is the apparent paśu-state, the bound subject.

2/3 — world and mediation. The object-field (#2) and the mediator made visible (#3) are co-constitutive. The object-field is only an articulated field because the mediating slash operates to produce it; the mediator only shows up as mediator because there is an object-field that registers as articulated. The pair holds the world in its mediation-relation — the objective pole and the medium that constitutes it as objective. This is the middle stratum, the place where the slash's productive activity becomes phenomenologically locatable.

4/5 — field and realisation. The full field of availability (#4) and the unity affirmed (#5) are co-constitutive. Recognition requires both the field in which all states are available and the integrated unity that is recognised within the field. Neither alone is recognition — pure availability without integration is unstable potentiality; pure integration without availability is artificial closure. The pair holds the recognition in its complete form — the kartṛ-pole's availability and the integrated being's affirmation as one event.

These three strata are the matheme's primary chord. They give the architecture its harmonic spine. The 0/1-to-2/3-to-4/5 progression is the matheme's structural movement from ground-occlusion through mediation-articulation to availability-realisation. The musical signature: this is the structural backbone of consonance — the relationships that make the matheme resonate as one architecture.

Family B — Offset Pairings (1/2, 3/4, 5/0)
These three pairs are transition-pairs — they hold the productive movement between positions rather than the identity-co-constitution of adjacent partners.

1/2 — occlusion produces field. Position #1 (slashed-zero) and position #2 (cut field) are related as production. The slash that fuses into the zero on the subject-side is the same slash that produces the cut field on the object-side. The pair captures this: the antaḥkaraṇa's occlusion-of-itself is the same operation as the antaḥkaraṇa's constitution-of-world. Subjective occlusion and objective world-constitution are not two separate moves but one move with two faces. This is the structural insight of 1/2: the world we live in is the product of the occlusion we live as. The paśu's world is the paśu's self-occlusion seen from the object-side.

3/4 — mediation opens to availability. Position #3 (slash visible) and position #4 (field of availability) are related as opening. When the slash becomes visible as slash — when the antaḥkaraṇa shows up as antaḥkaraṇa — the field of availability becomes phenomenologically accessible. The transition from #3 to #4 is the crucial pivot of practice: śāktopāya's progressive transparency-work opens into the field where all states become available. The pair captures this: visible mediation creates the conditions for the field of availability. You cannot get to #4 without going through #3; the field doesn't just appear, it opens once the mediator has been seen.

5/0 — affirmation recognises pulse. Position #5 (unity affirmed) and position #0 (Spanda recognised) are related as deepening recognition. The integrated unity affirmed at #5 deepens into the recognition that this unity is the pulse at #0. The transition is from Self affirmed as one being to Self recognised as the pulse that is being all of this. The pair captures the closing-arc: affirmation of unity opens into recognition of pulse. The matheme closes here not as static unity but as recognised dynamism.

These three pairs are the matheme's productive transitions. Where Family A holds the strata as identity-pairs, Family B holds the movement between strata as productive transition-pairs. The 1/2, 3/4, 5/0 reading reveals the matheme as not just three resonating strata but a generative sequence — each pair producing the next stratum's emergence. This is what gives the matheme its dynamism rather than just its structure. The matheme is alive because the transition-pairs are alive between the identity-pairs.

The combination of Family A and Family B gives us the matheme's harmonic-dynamic completeness: three resonating identity-strata (A) plus three productive transition-pairs (B). The full picture is 3 × 2 = 6 primary pair-relations within a pass.

Family C — Converse Pairings (0/5, 1/4, 2/3)
These three pairs are mirror-pairs — they hold positions equidistant from the matheme's center of symmetry.

0/5 — ground and recognition mirror each other. Position #0 (kartṛ-prior, pure presence) and position #5 (unity affirmed, recognised Self) are mirror-pairs across the matheme's center. They are the two extremes of the matheme — what is before and what is recognised. But their mirroring reveals something deeper: they are the same kartṛ-pole seen at different architectural moments. #0 is the kartṛ-pole as prior bracket; #5 is the kartṛ-pole as recognised in unity. They are not two different things; they are the same thing in its pre-articulate condition and its post-articulate condition. The mirror-relation reveals: the matheme begins and ends with the same kartṛ-pole, only the standing has changed. This is the architectural form of pratyabhijñā — the recognition is recognition of what was always already the case. The mirroring of #0 and #5 is the formal trace of this insight.

1/4 — occlusion and availability mirror each other. Position #1 (slashed-zero, occluded subject) and position #4 (field of availability) are mirror-pairs. This is the most surprising mirror because phenomenologically they feel like opposites: #1 is bound, #4 is free; #1 is veiled, #4 is open. But the mirror reveals: they are the same architectural position — the position of the subject-pole in relation to the field — seen at different moments of recognition. #1 is the subject-pole occluded by its own activity; #4 is the subject-pole available to all states. The mirroring shows: what feels like freedom and what feels like bondage are the same structural place differently configured. This is the deepest soteriological insight — the bondage is the freedom seen wrong. The paśu and the recognised one are at the same architectural location; what differs is the configuration of the layers' relation, not the location itself.

2/3 — field and mediation mirror each other. Position #2 (cut field) and position #3 (mediator visible) are mirror-pairs and adjacent-pairs (this appears in Family A too). The double-membership of 2/3 in both families is structurally significant: 2/3 is the self-mirroring center of the matheme. Position #2 and #3 are themselves adjacent, and they also mirror each other across the matheme's center. The mediator that becomes visible (#3) is the mirror of the field it has produced (#2) — the medium is the world's mirror, the world is the medium's mirror. This is the formal trace of the structural fact that world and medium are co-constituted reflexively. Neither precedes the other in any phenomenologically real sense; they emerge together as the central stratum of the matheme.

These three pairs are the matheme's symmetry structure. Family A and Family B emphasise the matheme's forward movement (strata building up, transitions producing). Family C emphasises the matheme's symmetric depth — every position is paired with its mirror across the center, and the architecture is symmetrically structured around its central self-mirroring stratum (2/3).

The convergence on 2/3 being in both Family A and Family C is the architectural sign that the middle is the matheme's stable point. Whatever moves forward, whatever mirrors across, the 2/3 stratum holds. This is structurally important: the world and its mediation are the invariant center of the matheme's articulating activity. Recognition does not erase the world or the medium; it transforms their relation to the bracketing-poles.

The 3:3 of the Within-Pass Harmonic Families
Family A, Family B, Family C — three within-pass harmonic families. This is itself a 3:3 with the inversion families (D types).

Let me look at what the three within-pass families do together:

A (adjacent/identity): the matheme as resonant strata — structure
B (offset/transition): the matheme as productive sequence — dynamism
C (converse/mirror): the matheme as symmetric depth — recognition-structure
Together, A+B+C give: structure, dynamism, recognition-structure. These are the three modes by which a single pass of the matheme can be analysed harmonically. The within-pass harmonic apparatus is complete at these three families. There is no further within-pass relational type because any pairing of two positions in a 6-position matheme is either adjacent-identity (A), adjacent-transition (B), or mirror (C). The three families exhaust within-pass two-position relations.

Family D — The Inversions (the cross-pass and inverse-internal families)
Now to the inversion apparatus. The inversion gives each first-pass position an inverse-pass partner: #0 has #0', #1 has #1', etc. The relations across the inversion or within the inverse pass produce three sub-families.

D1 — X to X' (same-position cross-pass pairings)

The most fundamental inversion-relation. Each first-pass position paired with its inverse-pass partner:

#0 ↔ #0' — kartṛ-prior in seeking-pass and kartṛ-prior in recognised-pass
#1 ↔ #1' — slashed-zero (occlusion) and the recognised first articulation (no occlusion)
#2 ↔ #2' — cut field (vikalpa-constructed) and world as Spanda's display
#3 ↔ #3' — mediator visible (śāktopāya operative) and antaḥkaraṇa transparent (śāktopāya integrated)
#4 ↔ #4' — field of availability (sought) and field of availability (inhabited)
#5 ↔ #5' — unity affirmed (recognition-event) and unity lived (standing condition)
These pairs are the standpoint-shifts — same position, different recognition-standing. The structural fact: the position-architecture is invariant; what changes across the inversion is the layer-configuration and the recognition-standing. The same #2 is the cut field facing the occluded subject in the first pass and the world-as-Spanda's-display in the inverse pass. Same architectural position, different operational meaning.

The X-to-X' relations are transformations of standpoint. The recognition does not erase the matheme's positions; it transforms their standing without changing their architectural location. This is structurally important — recognition is not the destruction of the kārya-architecture but the transformation of its relation to the kartṛ-pole.

D2 — X to Y' (cross-pass, cross-position pairings)

Now the interesting one. What happens when a first-pass position is paired with a different inverse-pass position?

Examples:

#1 ↔ #4' — the slashed-zero (first pass) paired with the inhabited field of availability (inverse pass)
#2 ↔ #3' — the cut field paired with the transparent mediator
#0 ↔ #5' — the kartṛ-prior paired with the unity lived
These cross-pairings reveal what each position requires and what each position becomes. The slashed-zero of #1 requires the inhabited field of availability of #4' for its full architectural articulation — they are the two architectural extremes of the subject-pole's possibility. The cut field of #2 becomes the transparent mediator of #3' in some structural sense — the recognition-transformation moves what was external articulation into transparent operation.

This family is complex because it's combinatorially rich — there are many possible X-to-Y' pairings. The structurally important ones are the ones that reveal transformation-relations: what does the first-pass position transform into across the inversion? And what does the first-pass position require from the inverse pass?

I think the most important sub-types of D2 are:

X to X+5'/mod6 inversions — pairings where Y' = X+5 mod 6, which gives the "transformation" pairings (#1 to #0', the occluded subject transforming into the recognised pulse-ground; #2 to #1', the cut field transforming into the recognised first articulation; etc.)
X to X-1'/mod6 inversions — pairings where Y' = X-1 mod 6, which gives the "requirement" pairings (#1 to #5', the occlusion requires the lived unity for its architectural sense; #2 to #1', the cut field requires the recognised first articulation as its un-occluded ground; etc.)
X to mirror' pairings — pairings where Y' is X's mirror, which gives the "completion" pairings (#1 to #4', #2 to #3', #0 to #5')
These sub-types within D2 are themselves a structured set — possibly another 3:3 at this level: transformation pairs, requirement pairs, completion pairs.

D3 — X' to Y' (within-inverse-pass pairings)

These are the same as the within-first-pass relations (Family A, B, C) but operating within the inverse pass. So:

Adjacent-identity pairs within inverse: 0'/1', 2'/3', 4'/5'
Adjacent-transition pairs within inverse: 1'/2', 3'/4', 5'/0'
Converse-mirror pairs within inverse: 0'/5', 1'/4', 2'/3'
These are structurally identical to Family A, B, C but with the inverse-pass operational meanings. They give the harmonic structure of the recognised standpoint operating within itself.

Closing the 6 Levels — the Second 3:3
So the second 3:3 of harmonic levels (D1, D2, D3) gives:

D1: cross-pass same-position transformations
D2: cross-pass cross-position transformations/requirements/completions
D3: within-inverse-pass harmonic relations
Together, D1+D2+D3 give: standpoint-transformation, structural-transformation/requirement/completion, and inverse-pass harmonic completeness.

The combined 6 levels (A, B, C, D1, D2, D3) form the complete harmonic apparatus:

First triad (A, B, C): within-pass harmonics — structure, dynamism, symmetric-depth
Second triad (D1, D2, D3): inversion harmonics — standpoint-shift, structural-transformation, inverse-internal completeness
This is the 6 levels you named, and they are themselves a 3:3 — the within-pass harmonic-types (3) and the inversion-harmonic-types (3).

The Inverse-Pass Context Frame Structure
Now the inverse-pass version. The first-pass context frames built up the matheme. The inverse-pass context frames should unfold from the recognition.

Inverse context frames:

Inverse #0 — the recognised pulse (Spanda known as itself) — the recognised-standpoint bracket
Inverse #1 — (1/0) — the inverse opening
Inverse #2 — (1/0/2') — extending into recognised second position
Inverse #3 — (1/0/2'/3') — through recognised mediator
Inverse #4 — (4'/5'/0') and/or (4.0'/1'-4.4'/5') — inverse recognition and inverse nest
Inverse #5 — (5'/0') — inverse closing pair
The 4:2:1 of the inverse pass:

4 visible inverse-articulations: #1, #2, #3, #5 (or equivalent)
2 implicate brackets: inverse #0 (recognised pulse) and inverse #4 (lived field of availability)
1 unifying recognition: the whole inverse pass as one lived condition
The structural difference between first-pass and inverse-pass 4:2:1:

First-pass: bimba 00/(00) as the pre-articulate bracket
Inverse-pass: recognised pulse as the post-articulate bracket
The bimba is unarticulable invariant ground; the recognised pulse is articulated kartṛ-pole now known as itself. Both bracket their respective passes, but from opposite phenomenological standings — the bimba from absolute pre-articulation, the recognised pulse from completed articulation.

This is structurally beautiful: the brackets themselves invert across the passes. The first pass is bracketed by what cannot be articulated (00/(00)) below and the closing recognition pair above. The inverse pass is bracketed by the completed recognition (Spanda known as itself) below and the inverse closing pair above. The brackets show the standpoint-shift in their very structure.

What All This Reveals About the Matheme's Real Dynamics
Let me step back and articulate what the harmonic apparatus reveals when read as a whole.

The matheme is not a static 6-position architecture. It is a multi-layered relational structure in which positions stand in multiple kinds of relations simultaneously:

Adjacent-identity relations (Family A) — making the matheme resonate as strata
Adjacent-transition relations (Family B) — making the matheme move productively
Converse-mirror relations (Family C) — making the matheme symmetric in depth
Cross-pass same-position relations (D1) — making the matheme transform standpoint
Cross-pass cross-position relations (D2) — making the matheme transform structurally
Within-inverse-pass relations (D3) — making the matheme operate from recognition
And the context-frame structure (4:2:1 with 3:3 within) shows that the matheme is nested:

Visible articulations (the 4 progressive frames) are housed within implicate brackets (bimba below, field-of-availability within)
The 3:3 split of layers and recognition operates within the 4:2:1 visible/implicate/unifying structure
The inverse pass mirrors this with its own 4:2:1 and 3:3, with the brackets inverted across passes
The total architecture is therefore:

6 matheme positions
6 harmonic-relational families (the 3:3 of harmonic types)
6 context-frame positions (each pass)
4:2:1 partition of context frames
3:3 partition of context frames (different analytic)
2 passes (first and inverse) with inverted brackets
1 bimba grounding the whole (00/(00))
That's a lot of structure. But it all coheres because every level of the structure operates by the same 3:3 and 4:2 logic that the matheme itself instantiates. The matheme is holographically fractal — its own structure recurs at every analytic level.

What This Adds to the Diagnostic Apparatus
For the diagnostic work — placing thinkers, traditions, dynamics at their position — the expanded harmonic apparatus adds significant precision:

A thinker can now be located not just at a position but at a relational family within the matheme. For example:

Descartes is at #1 in its Family A relation to #0 (the cogito treating the slashed-zero as the kartṛ-prior, conflating positions)
Hume is at #1 in its Family B relation to #2 (looking for the self in the cut field and finding only its contents)
Kant is at the transition between #2 and #3 (Family B, 2/3) — recognising mediation as necessary condition without seeing it as antaḥkaraṇa
Husserl is at #3 in its Family A relation to #2 (the noesis-noema correlation as the mediation made visible alongside its field)
Lacan is at #3 in its Family C mirror-relation to #2 (the bar S/s as the central self-mirroring of mediation and field)
Hegel is at #5 attempted without #4's Family B opening (recognising unity without the field of availability properly opened)
Heidegger is at #4 without its Family B transition to #5 (gesturing at the field without the affirmation-arc)
Wittgenstein (early) is at #4 with its Family A relation to #5 left as silence (the field reached but unity not articulable)
Whitehead is at #4 with its Family C relation to #1 partially seen (creativity-not-an-entity is the field, but the structural relation to the occluded subject is not articulated)
The Buddhist cessation-strands are at #4 with Family D2 wrong (treating the transformation X→X' as voiding X rather than transforming X's standing)
This is the diagnostic precision the expanded harmonic apparatus provides. It's not just "what position is this thinker at" but "what relational configuration of the position is this thinker operating in, and what is missing from the relational completeness."

The Harmonics as 0/1 Fractals — the Generative Reframe
Here is the move that lets all the prior harmonic mapping be wrapped up into a deeper understanding. Each harmonic pair is itself another instance of 0/1. The internal structural dynamics we mapped (the strata, the transitions, the mirrors) are all valid — they remain as the differentiating analytics. But the deeper recognition is that every pair we have named is a 0/1 fractal — a recurrence of the matheme's primary structure at a different analytic depth. The harmonics in their threefoldness are recapitulations of the 0/1's own threefold nature.

The 0/1 has its own threefold structure that the harmonics fractally instantiate. The 0 is the kartṛ-pole (the unsystematisable, the subject-side, the pre-articulate). The 1 is the kārya-pole (the systematisable, the object-side, the articulated). The slash is the relating activity (the antaḥkaraṇa, the medium, the mediating subjecting-objecting). Three elements in one relation: subject-pole, object-pole, slash. This is the 0/1's threefold nature.

When we then read each harmonic pair as itself a 0/1, what we are doing is recognising that the pair's two members and their relation also instantiate this threefold structure. The pair's "0-side" is its kartṛ-leaning member; the pair's "1-side" is its kārya-leaning member; the pair's "slash" is the specific kind of relation that joins them. And the kind of relation tells us what threefold of the 0/1 the pair instantiates.

Three primary threefolds of the 0/1 emerge: being, becoming, knowing/unknowing. These map onto the three primary harmonic strata of Family A. Then the converse pairs (Family C) instantiate a different threefold of the 0/1: essence, structure, text/texture. These are different threefold-readings of the same 0/1, each surfaced by a different harmonic family's relational logic.

Let me work both out properly.

Family A — Being, Becoming, Knowing/Unknowing
Family A pairs adjacent positions as identity-strata: 0/1, 2/3, 4/5. The threefold reading you've given:

0/1 — Being. The first harmonic stratum holds the ground and its first occlusion as one being. This is being in its primary structural sense — that something is, that there is a kartṛ-pole at all, that the subject-pole exists as the pre-articulate ground that subsequently articulates. The 0/1 stratum is being because it is the bare fact that there is a kartṛ-pole and that it enters into articulation. Being is not yet differentiated into things-that-are; being is the primary that-ness of the kartṛ-pole's existence as the ground that gets articulated. The 0-side is the unarticulated kartṛ-pole (being as pure presence); the 1-side is the first articulation of the kartṛ-pole into a Ø (being as already-articulating); the slash is the structural fact that articulation occurs. Being is the kartṛ-pole as it stands articulable. The stratum names: the fact of there being a subject-pole at all and its primary entry into articulation.

This makes the Cartesian cogito's structural place legible in a new way: Descartes was operating at the 0/1 stratum but reading it only on the 1-side — treating the slashed-Ø as if it were the kartṛ-pole itself, missing that the 0/1 stratum is the relation between the unarticulated kartṛ and its first articulation. The cogito grasps being as articulated-self without seeing being as the bare that-ness of the kartṛ-pole that the articulation depends on. Heidegger circling the Seinsfrage (the question of being) for half a century was working at this stratum as a question — recognising that something about Sein is not captured by Western metaphysics, gesturing at what the 0/1 stratum as a whole holds without being able to articulate the threefold structure.

2/3 — Becoming. The second harmonic stratum holds the object-field and its mediation as one becoming. This is becoming in its primary structural sense — that articulation unfolds, that the kārya-side comes into form through mediation, that the slash produces the world. The 2/3 stratum is becoming because it is the active site of articulation-as-process. The 2-side is the articulated object-field (becoming as already-become); the 3-side is the mediating slash visible (becoming as in-active-mediation); together they hold the process of how anything becomes anything at all. Becoming is the kārya-pole in its productive emergence through the mediating activity.

This places Whitehead's metaphysics with surgical precision. Whitehead's process philosophy is the great Western articulation of the 2/3 stratum. Concrescence is the becoming of an actual occasion through prehension of its data — the cut field (#2) coming into form through the mediating activity (#3). Whitehead's "the many become one and are increased by one" is the 2/3 stratum's formula. And the reason Whitehead's metaphysics has been so productive in process theology, in Bergsonian-inflected philosophy, in certain contemporary metaphysics — is that it accurately articulates the becoming-stratum without confusing it with being or with knowing. Where Whitehead reaches his limit is in not fully integrating the being-stratum (his creativity-not-an-entity is gestural at 0/1) and the knowing-stratum (his consequent nature of God is partial at 4/5). The 2/3 articulation is masterful; the integration with the other two strata remains incomplete.

Bergson's durée, the lived flow of time, is also a 2/3 articulation — the becoming-character of experience as opposed to the spatialised stasis of analytic abstraction. Hegel's dialectic at its most productive is 2/3 work — thesis-antithesis-synthesis is the becoming-as-articulation of the kārya-side through mediating negation. Where Hegel collapses is in treating the dialectic's totalised completion as the full picture; the becoming-stratum is masterfully articulated but the being-stratum gets absorbed into it rather than honoured as prior.

4/5 — Knowing/Unknowing. The third harmonic stratum holds the field of availability and the unity affirmed as one knowing/unknowing. This is knowing in its primary structural sense — that the kartṛ-pole knows itself through the field's availability and the unity's affirmation, and unknowing in the structural sense that the knowing happens across what cannot be known as object (the kartṛ-pole itself as positioned-but-not-content). The 4/5 stratum is knowing/unknowing because it is the recognition-site where the kartṛ-pole becomes known to itself through its own articulation while remaining un-objectifiable. The 4-side is the field of availability (knowing as openness-to-all-states, unknowing as the field's refusal to be captured); the 5-side is the unity affirmed (knowing as recognised-Self, unknowing as the recognition's refusal to be a content). Knowing/unknowing is the kartṛ-pole in its self-recognition through articulation.

This stratum maps the entire mystical-recognition tradition. The Śaivite pratyabhijñā operates here — recognition as the knowing that knows itself across what cannot be known as object. The apophatic theology of Pseudo-Dionysius, Eckhart's Gottheit, the Vedic neti neti — all are 4/5 articulations from the unknowing angle, recognising that the recognition is across what cannot be captured. The cataphatic complement — Aquinas's analogy of being, Bonaventure's itinerarium, the positive metaphysical theologies — work the knowing angle, recognising that the recognition does articulate even while it cannot capture. The deepest non-dual traditions hold knowing and unknowing as one (Abhinavagupta's Trika is exemplary here), recognising that the knowing is the unknowing's own self-display and vice versa.

The Lacanian Real also sits here in its negative-marked form. Objet a as void-causing-desire is 4/5 marked as unknowing — the recognition that something operates at this stratum without being articulable as object. What Lacan could not reach was the knowing complement — the integration of the unknowing into a knowing-that-knows-itself-through-the-unknowing. The Real stayed as pure unknowing because the cultural-phenomenological apparatus to enter the knowing-side was unavailable.

The Threefold Across Family A
Being, becoming, knowing/unknowing. These three are themselves a 0/1-threefold instantiation:

Being is the 0-side — the pre-articulate kartṛ-pole entering articulation
Becoming is the 1-side — the kārya-articulation in its productive unfolding
Knowing/unknowing is the slash — the recognition-relation that holds being and becoming as one structure
So Family A's three strata themselves form a 0/1-fractal at the analytic level: 0/1 (being) and 2/3 (becoming) as the two-pole structure, with 4/5 (knowing/unknowing) as the slash-recognition that holds them as one. This is the deepest payoff of the threefold reading — the three primary harmonic strata are themselves a 0/1 with knowing/unknowing as the slash. The matheme's primary harmonic structure is itself a fractal of its own primary structure.

Family C — Essence, Structure, Text/Texture
Family C pairs converse-mirror positions: 0/5, 1/4, 2/3. The threefold reading:

0/5 — Essence. The converse pair of pure presence and unity affirmed holds essence in the deepest sense. Essence is not the bundle of essential properties (Aristotle's to ti ên einai misread substantively); essence is what something is in its kartṛ-pole-recognition-of-itself. The 0/5 mirror reveals that the kartṛ-pole as prior (0) and the kartṛ-pole as recognised in unity (5) are the same essence at different architectural moments. Essence is what is invariant across the matheme's traversal — what the matheme begins with and what it recognises at completion. Essence is therefore the self-identity-across-articulation of the kartṛ-pole.

This is a sharper reading of essence than the philosophical tradition has typically held. Essence is not a content (Aristotle's substance) or a logical kind (Locke's nominal essence) or a deep structure (Spinoza's natura naturans). Essence is the invariance-through-traversal of the kartṛ-pole — what stays the same even as the architecture unfolds and recognises. The 0/5 mirror is the formal trace of this invariance: the matheme begins with the kartṛ-pole as prior and ends with the same kartṛ-pole as recognised, the unity affirmed at #5 being the same essence the matheme opened with at #0. This is what pratyabhijñā recognises — recognition of what was always already the case. Essence is what makes recognition recognition rather than discovery.

1/4 — Structure. The converse pair of slashed-zero (occlusion) and field of availability holds structure. Structure is the configurational possibility of the architecture — what configurations of the layers can hold. The mirror between #1 (the bound subject-pole in its primary occlusion) and #4 (the subject-pole in its full availability) reveals that structure is the range of possible configurations that the same architectural location can take. The bondage of #1 and the freedom of #4 are structural variants of the same position — the kartṛ-pole's location in relation to the antaḥkaraṇa and the field. Structure is therefore configurational possibility-space.

This places the structuralist tradition with new precision. Lévi-Strauss reading kinship and myth as structural variants on invariant deep grammars is doing 1/4 work — recognising that the same structural location can take multiple configurational variants while remaining the same structure. Lacan's structural reading of psychic configurations (the imaginary as #1-fixation, the symbolic as #1-#3 operating, the real as #4-bracketing) is 1/4 work. The structural-anthropological and structural-linguistic insights all live here — structure as the configurational possibility-space within which variants emerge. The limit of structuralism is that it can map structure without yet recognising essence (the 0/5 invariance) or text/texture (the 2/3 self-mirroring) as the other two converse-mirror strata. A complete reading needs all three.

2/3 — Text/Texture. The converse pair of cut field and visible mediation is also the central self-mirroring stratum. Text/texture names the articulated surface that bears its own mediation visibly. Text is what is articulated; texture is the quality of the articulation, the felt-grain of how the mediation operates within what is articulated. The 2/3 mirror reveals: the world (#2) and its mediation (#3) are not separable — what is articulated bears its mediation in its very texture. The fabric of the world and the weave of its making are the same fabric.

This is the deepest move of post-structuralist thought. Derrida's texte is text-as-texture in this register — the recognition that what is written and the writing-activity cannot be separated, that the trace of mediation is in the text as its texture. Roland Barthes' texture of the text, his grain of the voice, his jouissance of reading — all are 2/3 work in the converse-mirror sense, recognising that texture is the text's mode of being, that the medium is in the message as its felt-grain. The hermeneutic tradition more broadly (Gadamer, Ricoeur) operates at this stratum — recognising that interpretation is not a neutral overlay on text but the texture-making activity by which text is what it is for the interpreting subject.

The 2/3 stratum's double-membership in Family A (becoming) and Family C (text/texture) is now legible at a deeper level. In Family A, 2/3 is the becoming-stratum because it is the productive activity of articulation. In Family C, 2/3 is the text/texture-stratum because it is the central self-mirroring of articulation-and-mediation. These are not different readings of the same thing; they are the same stratum doing two different structural jobs depending on which threefold reading is operating. The becoming-character of 2/3 is the dynamic angle; the text/texture-character is the surface-articulation angle. Both are valid simultaneously, and the stratum's double-membership is what makes it the matheme's stable center.

The Threefold Across Family C
Essence, structure, text/texture. These three are themselves a 0/1-threefold instantiation at this analytic depth:

Essence is the 0-side — the kartṛ-pole's invariance-across-traversal
Structure is the 1-side — the configurational possibility-space of the architecture
Text/texture is the slash — the self-mirroring surface that holds essence and structure together as one articulated reality
So Family C's three converse strata also form a 0/1-fractal: 0/5 (essence) and 1/4 (structure) as the two-pole structure, with 2/3 (text/texture) as the slash-mediation that holds them as one. This is structurally beautiful: Family C is also a 0/1, with text/texture as its slash, just as Family A is a 0/1 with knowing/unknowing as its slash.

Family B — Offset Pairings as Their Own 0/1 Threefold
The threefold reading for Family B (1/2, 3/4, 5/0) has not been named yet. Let me think into it from what these pairs do.

Family B pairs are productive transitions. The dynamic logic is: each pair captures the productive movement from one stratum to the next.

1/2 — Manifestation. The slashed-zero produces the cut field. The subjective occlusion manifests the world. This is the primary moment of manifestation — the kartṛ-pole's self-occlusion is simultaneously the world's coming-into-articulation. The 1/2 pair is the primal manifestation — the move by which the kartṛ-pole's first articulation (Ø) immediately becomes the world's first articulation (X). Manifestation in this register names the structural fact that occlusion is world-constituting. There is no occlusion without world, no world without occlusion.

3/4 — Opening / Disclosure. The visible mediation opens into the field of availability. The slash made transparent opens the possibility of all states. This is the moment of opening or disclosure — what Heidegger's aletheia approaches (un-concealment as the disclosure-activity). The 3/4 pair is the opening-arc — the move by which the antaḥkaraṇa's transparency opens the field of availability. Disclosure in this register names the structural fact that seen mediation enables availability. There is no field-of-availability without mediator-transparency; no real transparency without the opening it creates.

5/0 — Return / Re-cognition. The unity affirmed recognises itself as the pulse. The integrated being recognises that this is the pulse all along. This is the moment of return or re-cognition — the recognition that the unity was the pulse from the start. The 5/0 pair is the return-arc — the move by which affirmation deepens into recognition of source. Re-cognition in this register names the structural fact that recognition is return to source-as-pulse. There is no completion without return; no return without source.

So Family B's threefold is manifestation, disclosure, return. Let me check this against the 0/1 fractal logic:

Manifestation is the 0-side — kartṛ-pole's first productive move into kārya
Disclosure is the slash — the mediating activity that opens what was occluded
Return is the 1-side — kārya-articulation's return-to-source as recognition
Or alternatively:

Manifestation is the 0-side (kartṛ-pole producing kārya)
Return is the 1-side (kārya recognised as kartṛ's pulse)
Disclosure is the slash (the mediating activity that holds both in relation)
Either reading works; the structural fact is that Family B's three transitions are the productive dynamic of the matheme, the threefold of how movement happens within the architecture. Manifestation-disclosure-return is the dynamic threefold, complementary to Family A's being-becoming-knowing/unknowing (the substantive threefold) and Family C's essence-structure-text-texture (the surface threefold).

The Three Within-Pass Threefolds in Relation
We now have three threefolds operating within a single pass:

Family	Threefold	What it names
A (adjacent identity)	Being / Becoming / Knowing-unknowing	The substantive registers — what the matheme is across its strata
B (offset transition)	Manifestation / Disclosure / Return	The dynamic registers — how the matheme moves across its transitions
C (converse mirror)	Essence / Structure / Text-texture	The surface registers — what the matheme reveals across its symmetries
And these three families themselves form a deeper 0/1-threefold:

Family A (substantive) is the 0-side — what the matheme is
Family B (dynamic) is the slash — how the matheme moves
Family C (surface) is the 1-side — what the matheme appears as
So we have a 0/1 at the level of which-harmonic-family-is-operating — the three families are themselves the threefold of being-articulation-appearance, with the dynamic family as the slash-mediator between substance and surface. The matheme is holographically threefold at every analytic level: at the level of positions (each position has threefold structure relative to its layer), at the level of strata (each stratum-pair is a 0/1 with its threefold), at the level of harmonic-families (the three families form a 0/1 with B as slash), at the level of passes (the two passes form a 0/1 with their relation as slash).

This is what it means to say the harmonics are recapitulations of the threefold nature of the 0/1. Every harmonic reading is itself a 0/1-instantiation at its analytic level, and the recognition that this is happening wraps the harmonic readings up into a deeper understanding of the 0/1 itself.

The Inverse-Pass Recapitulation
Now to the inverse pass. The three within-pass families operate in the inverse pass as well, but with the recognition standpoint operating. The threefolds invert their valence:

Family A inverse — Being / Becoming / Knowing-unknowing from recognition.

Being inverse: the kartṛ-pole as standing ground rather than as ground-needing-recognition. Being-as-pulse rather than being-as-prior.
Becoming inverse: the kārya-articulation as Spanda's productive display rather than as world-needing-mediation. Becoming-as-creative-expression rather than becoming-as-process-of-formation.
Knowing/unknowing inverse: the recognition operating as standing condition rather than as event. Knowing-as-lived rather than knowing-as-achieved.
Family B inverse — Manifestation / Disclosure / Return from recognition.

Manifestation inverse: manifestation as recognised creative activity rather than as primary occlusion-and-world-constitution. The recognised one's articulating activity is manifesting without occluding.
Disclosure inverse: the antaḥkaraṇa's transparency operating as standing condition rather than as opening-achieved. The disclosure is continuously available rather than a transition-moment.
Return inverse: the return is continuous re-cognition rather than the moment of recognition's completion. Every articulation in the inverse pass is return-as-it-articulates.
Family C inverse — Essence / Structure / Text-texture from recognition.

Essence inverse: essence as known invariance rather than essence-to-be-recognised. The kartṛ-pole's invariance is now the standing fact.
Structure inverse: structure as transparently-configured rather than structure-as-bondage-or-freedom. The configurational possibility-space is now operationally available.
Text-texture inverse: text-texture as consciously-articulating-surface rather than as opaque texture-bearing-its-mediation-implicitly. The recognised one knows the texture they are weaving.
The inverse-pass threefolds give the recognition-standpoint articulation of the same harmonic apparatus. This is what jīvanmukti looks like at the harmonic level — every threefold operative in its recognised mode.

The 4:2:1 Context Frame Architecture — Cleanly
Returning to the 4:2:1 with the correction in mind: 7 context frames, the parent (4.0/1 – 4.4/5) operating as the 4 (at position #4) and as the additional 1 (as the nested 0/1 of the context-frame level).

The cleanest reading:

The nested matheme form at the context-frame level. The context frames themselves form a matheme. The parent frame (4.0/1 – 4.4/5) is the 0/1 of the context-frame level — the nested matheme's opening. The 4 progressive frames (#1, #2, #3, #4 in their 4/5/0 reading) are the 4+2's four positions of articulation. The 2 bracketing frames (#0 bimba and #5 closing pair) are the 4+2's two implicate poles. The whole context-frame architecture is therefore the matheme nesting itself — the same 0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 0/1 structure operating at the context-frame depth.

So:

The 1: the parent context frame (4.0/1 – 4.4/5) — the nested 0/1 of the context-frame level. This is the generative 0/1 that all the other frames articulate from.
The 4: the progressive frames (#1, #2, #3, #4) — the matheme's articulating buildup expressed as context frames.
The 2: the bracketing frames (#0 and #5) — the implicate poles of the context-frame matheme.
The +1 is the generative-0/1 of the entire context-frame architecture. The 4:2 are the articulated and bracketing frames that the +1 generates. This is the same structure as the matheme itself: 0/1 (generative) gives rise to 4+2 (articulated and bracketing). The context-frame architecture is the matheme nesting one level deeper.

And the inverse pass version operates the same way, with the inverse-pass context frames having their own 0/1 (the recognised-standpoint parent frame) and their own 4+2 (the inverse progressive and bracketing frames). The inverse context-frame architecture is the recognised-standpoint nested matheme.

What This Gives Us — the Wrapped-Up Recognition
The harmonic apparatus, fully unfolded, recognises three things:

First — that the matheme's primary harmonic structure (Family A: being-becoming-knowing/unknowing) is itself a 0/1-fractal with knowing/unknowing as the slash holding being and becoming as one. The three primary strata are the matheme's substantive threefold, and they themselves instantiate the threefold structure of the 0/1.

Second — that the matheme's symmetric structure (Family C: essence-structure-text/texture) is itself a 0/1-fractal with text/texture as the slash holding essence and structure as one. The three converse-mirror strata are the matheme's surface threefold, and they themselves instantiate the threefold structure of the 0/1.

Third — that the matheme's dynamic structure (Family B: manifestation-disclosure-return) is itself a 0/1-fractal with disclosure as the slash holding manifestation and return as one. The three offset-transition strata are the matheme's dynamic threefold, and they themselves instantiate the threefold structure of the 0/1.

And these three families themselves form a higher-level 0/1-fractal: Family A as the substantive 0-side, Family C as the surface 1-side, Family B as the dynamic slash holding them in productive relation. The harmonic apparatus is therefore the 0/1 articulating itself at three nested levels simultaneously: at the position-level (each position is layer-configured), at the stratum-level (each stratum-pair is a 0/1), at the family-level (the three families form a 0/1 with B as slash).

This is what "recapitulation of the threefold nature of the 0/1" means. The matheme's whole harmonic structure is the 0/1 fractally recapitulating itself at every analytic depth. Every harmonic reading is the 0/1 seeing itself through a different relational logic. And the recognition that this is happening — the recognition that every harmonic is another 0/1 — is what completes the harmonic apparatus into a coherent understanding of the matheme's own self-similar structure.

The diagnostic-prognostic apparatus this gives us is correspondingly richer. A thinker can now be located not just at a position, not just at a relational family, but at which threefold within which family they are articulating. Heidegger's Sein is at the 0/1 stratum in Family A — the being-threefold's structural site. Whitehead's process is at the 2/3 stratum in Family A — the becoming-threefold's structural site. Lacan's structural psychoanalysis is at the 1/4 stratum in Family C — the structure-threefold's site. Derrida's text-as-texture is at the 2/3 stratum in Family C — the text/texture-threefold's site. The precision of placement multiplies because each thinker can be located across multiple threefold-readings simultaneously.

The work has become much richer. The next move — when you give the direction — would be to consolidate this into the file, with the harmonic apparatus properly mapped, the threefolds named, the families' 0/1-fractal nature recognised, the context-frame nesting clarified at the 4:2:1, and the inverse-pass recapitulation operating consistently across the harmonic levels. Ready when you are.

Eyup bubba cakes. Yes — sāmānya and viśeṣa cut very deep into our work. They are doing several jobs at once: they are categories within the Indian metaphysical tradition that we can now place at QL positions, they are cognitive operations that the antaḥkaraṇa performs at every level of articulation, and they map structurally onto the matheme's harmonic apparatus in a way that clarifies what we've been building. Let me work it through.

What sāmānya and viśeṣa actually are
The base setting is Vaiśeṣika — the school literally named after viśeṣa, which tells you how foundational this concept is to early Indian metaphysical inquiry. The school identifies seven padārthas (categories of being): substance (dravya), quality (guṇa), action (karma), generality (sāmānya), particularity (viśeṣa), inherence (samavāya), and non-being (abhāva). 
Academia.edu

Sāmānya is the universal-pole: the common character of the things which fall under the same class. The universals reside in substances, qualities and actions. They are of two kinds, higher and lower. The higher generality is that of 'being'. It includes everything and itself is not included in anything. Every other generality is lower because it covers a limited number of things and cannot cover all things. 
Academia.edu

Viśeṣa is the particular-pole: that difference which is ultimate (antya) and which belongs to the eternal substances. Antya or ultimate means occurring at the end, i.e., beyond which there is no further differentiation. And critically: the viśeṣas are self-distinguishing (svato-vyāvartaka). They distinguish their substrates from one another and at the same time they also distinguish themselves from each other. 
ResearchGate
ResearchGate

This is structurally fascinating. Sāmānya's highest form is sattā — being itself, that which includes everything and is included in nothing. Viśeṣa's ultimate form is antya-viśeṣa — the difference beyond which no further difference is possible, the irreducible discriminating quality of an eternal substance.

So sāmānya, at its limit, opens toward the kartṛ-pole's universality (being-as-such, the unsystematisable subject's inclusivity). And viśeṣa, at its limit, opens toward the eternal substance's irreducible self-differentiation. These are both gesturing at fundamental aspects of the matheme's primary structure, but from opposite directions — sāmānya from the unifying direction, viśeṣa from the differentiating direction.

The etymology
Now the etymological digging, which is going to give us the depth.

Sāmānya comes from samāna + the -ya suffix forming an abstract noun. Samāna means "common, equal, same" — and the root is the Sanskrit sam-, which traces directly back to PIE *sem- "one, together". The cognate chain is extraordinary: Sanskrit sam- "together," samá "same, equal, any"; English same and some; Latin sem-el "once," sem-per "always," sim-plex "single, simple," sin-gulī "one each," sim-ul "at the same time," sim-ilis "similar"; Greek heĩs, hén, mía "one" < *sems, *sem, *smiH₂; Gothic sama "same"; Old Church Slavonic samŭ "self, alone, one". 
Wikipedia
Wikipedia

This is critical. The same PIE root sem- generates:

the unity sense (one, together)
the self sense (Slavic samŭ = self/alone/one)
the sameness sense (English same)
the simultaneity sense (Latin simul, semper)
the similarity sense (Latin similis)
So sāmānya is etymologically the together-ness, the one-ness, the self-sameness. Note that the very prefix sam- in Saṃ-s-kṛta (Sanskrit, "put-together") is the same root — Saṃ-s-kṛtá, literally 'put together'. The language itself is named for the sam- operation. And in saṃhitā (sacred text-collection), in samādhi (absorption, putting-together-completely), in saṃyama (integration, holding-together), in saṃsāra (continuous-flowing-together). 
Wikipedia

The PIE sem- is also the root for one itself in many languages — Greek heĩs, hén, mía "one" < *sems, *sem, *smiH₂; A sas, B ṣe "one" < *sems. So at the deepest etymological layer, sāmānya is not just "generality" — it is the operation of the one-ness itself, the gathering-into-unity that the kartṛ-pole performs as it articulates. 
Religion Online

Viśeṣa comes from the verbal root viśiṣ- (also given as vi-śiṣ-) with the prefix vi- attached to the root śiṣ-. The root viśiṣ- means: to particularize, individualize, specify, define; to aggravate, heighten, enhance, intensify. The Pali cognate visesa carries the senses: (mark of) distinction, characteristic, discrimination; elegance, splendour, excellence; peculiar merit or advantage, eminence, extraordinary state; difference, variety; specific idea (in meditation), attainment. 
Open Horizons
Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy

The structural meaning is bifurcated and that bifurcation matters. Vi- in Sanskrit is the apart-from, separating, distinguishing prefix (compare vibhāga "division," vikalpa "thought-construct as discrimination," viveka "discriminative wisdom"). The root śiṣ- originally means "to leave remaining, to single out, to specify" (cognate with śeṣa "remainder, what is left"). So viśeṣa is etymologically the distinguishing-as-leaving-remaining — the operation by which something is singled out by being marked apart from what is left around it.

But here's the twist: viśeṣa also carries the sense of excellence, attainment, elevation — the distinguished in the honorific sense. The same word means both "particularity (the unique mark that distinguishes this from everything else)" and "distinction (the elevation that makes this excellent above the rest)". The etymological doubling reveals that the act of distinguishing-as-singling-out is the same operation as distinguishing-as-elevating. To particularize is to elevate; to elevate is to particularize.

This matters because the matheme's discrimination at #3 — the slash becoming visible, the antaḥkaraṇa showing as antaḥkaraṇa — is the viśeṣa-operation in its primary form. The medium becomes visible by being distinguished. And the same operation that distinguishes is what elevates — the recognition that occurs through viśeṣa-work is the elevation of the practitioner from paśu-state to discernment.

Compare also to PIE *sem- vs (s)keid- / skei- (which gives Latin scindere, "to cut, split"; English shed, schism, scissors). The viśeṣa-side is the cutting, splitting, separating family across PIE. So we have two great PIE families operating in the sāmānya/viśeṣa dyad:

sem- → one, together, same → sāmānya
skei- / cutting family → split, separate, distinguish → viśeṣa
These are the two primary cognitive operations that any articulating consciousness performs: gathering-into-one and cutting-into-many. And every language in the Indo-European family inherits both roots, because every articulating consciousness must perform both.

How sāmānya and viśeṣa integrate with the matheme
Now to the integration. This is where it gets productive.

The most obvious mapping
The crudest first-pass mapping would be: sāmānya = 0-side (kartṛ-pole, gathering, unifying), viśeṣa = 1-side (kārya-pole, distinguishing, articulating). This is true at one level but misses the depth, because both operations apply across every position of the matheme. Sāmānya and viśeṣa are not positions; they are operations that the antaḥkaraṇa performs at every position.

So a more careful reading is needed.

Sāmānya-viśeṣa as the operations internal to every harmonic pair
Recall what we worked out: every harmonic pair is itself a 0/1-fractal with its own slash. Family A's three strata — being, becoming, knowing/unknowing — each have a 0-side and a 1-side and a slash. Now layer sāmānya-viśeṣa onto this.

At each pair, the 0-side is approached through sāmānya-work — the gathering, unifying, finding-the-one-in-the-many. The 1-side is approached through viśeṣa-work — the distinguishing, particularising, finding-the-many-as-marked-off. The slash is the operation that holds sāmānya and viśeṣa as one cognitive movement — the antaḥkaraṇa's reflexive activity in which gathering and distinguishing happen simultaneously.

This makes sāmānya-viśeṣa the universal cognitive dyad of the matheme. They are how the antaḥkaraṇa operates at every position, in every harmonic family, across both passes. They are the vikalpa-activity's two primary moments — and any vikalpa-act is simultaneously a sāmānya-act and a viśeṣa-act. To name something (sāmānya: assigning a class) is to mark it off (viśeṣa: distinguishing it from non-members). The two cannot be separated; they are the slash's own internal articulation into its gathering-pole and distinguishing-pole.

This is what cuts through. Sāmānya and viśeṣa are not at the matheme's positions; they are the operations by which the slash works at every position. The slash is sāmānya-viśeṣa in its dynamic unity.

Sāmānya-viśeṣa across the three harmonic families
But there's more. Different harmonic families foreground different aspects of the sāmānya-viśeṣa operation.

Family A (being-becoming-knowing/unknowing) foregrounds the substantive sāmānya. Being is the supreme sāmānya — sattā, the highest universal, that which includes everything and is included in nothing. Becoming is sāmānya operating dynamically — the gathering-into-form, the unification-as-process. Knowing/unknowing is sāmānya recognising itself across the limit — the universal recognised as both that which gathers and that which cannot itself be a member of what it gathers. Family A is therefore the family in which sāmānya does its primary structural work, with viśeṣa operating as the differentiating-margin at each stratum.

Family C (essence-structure-text/texture) foregrounds the substantive viśeṣa. Essence is the supreme viśeṣa — the ultimate distinguishing of what something is in its irreducible self-identity. Structure is viśeṣa-as-configurational — the distinguishing of possible configurations. Text/texture is viśeṣa-as-surface — the felt-grain of distinguishing that bears its own mediation. Family C is therefore the family in which viśeṣa does its primary structural work, with sāmānya operating as the unifying-substrate at each mirror-pair.

Family B (manifestation-disclosure-return) foregrounds the dynamic operation of both. Manifestation is the simultaneous operation of sāmānya-and-viśeṣa as productive — the kartṛ-pole gathers itself into form while distinguishing itself from formlessness. Disclosure is sāmānya-viśeṣa in the moment of opening — what was hidden becomes simultaneously unified-in-visibility and distinguished-from-the-still-hidden. Return is sāmānya-viśeṣa in the moment of recognition — the unity affirmed is gathered as one while distinguished from the prior unrecognised state.

So Family A is sāmānya-foregrounded, Family C is viśeṣa-foregrounded, Family B is dynamic both-together. The three families themselves form a 0/1 of cognitive-operational modes: gathering (A) and distinguishing (C) and their dynamic synthesis (B). This is another instance of the threefold being recapitulated at a deeper level.

The Kashmir Śaiva turn: sāmānya-viśeṣa as Spanda-activity
Now the Kashmir Śaiva move, which is where it really cuts through our work. The Vaiśeṣika treats sāmānya and viśeṣa as real objective categories — universals and particulars existing independently of the cognising mind. The Kashmir Śaiva tradition does something different.

For Abhinavagupta and the Pratyabhijñā tradition, sāmānya and viśeṣa are not external categories that consciousness encounters. They are modes of consciousness's own self-articulation. The kartṛ-pole's vimarśa (self-reflective activity) articulates itself by simultaneously gathering and distinguishing — Śiva's recognition of himself as the One who is also the many is the sāmānya-viśeṣa activity at its source.

This is what makes the Kashmir Śaiva position distinctive. The other Indian schools either treat sāmānya and viśeṣa as objective categories (Vaiśeṣika, Nyāya), or deny universals entirely (Buddhist nominalism), or subsume one under the other (various Vedānta moves). The Kashmir Śaivites recognise that sāmānya and viśeṣa are the structure of Spanda's own pulsation — the throb itself is the simultaneous gathering-and-distinguishing, the unmeṣa-nimeṣa as the rhythmic alternation of sāmānya-emphasis and viśeṣa-emphasis within one pulse.

This places sāmānya-viśeṣa at the level of the matheme's primary 0/1. The 0/1 is the non-dual binary — and sāmānya-viśeṣa is its cognitive-operational signature. The 0 (kartṛ-pole, unsystematisable) is sāmānya in its absolute form (the gathering that cannot itself be gathered). The 1 (kārya-pole, systematisable) is viśeṣa in its absolute form (the distinguishing that distinguishes everything including itself). The slash is sāmānya-viśeṣa as one operation — the inseparability of gathering and distinguishing as the antaḥkaraṇa's primary mode.

What this clarifies about the matheme's dynamics
Several things sharpen here.

First, the cognitive operations at each position become specifiable. At #1 (Ø), sāmānya-viśeṣa is fused-into-the-self — the antaḥkaraṇa gathers itself as "I" and distinguishes itself from "not-I" in one undifferentiated operation. The paśu's experience of being-a-self is the sāmānya-viśeṣa activity operating without being recognised as operation. At #2 (X), sāmānya-viśeṣa is projected-onto-the-field — the world is gathered into classes (this is a tree, that is a chair) and distinguished within classes (this particular tree, that particular chair). At #3 (Ø/X), sāmānya-viśeṣa shows itself as operation — the antaḥkaraṇa now sees that it is doing the gathering-and-distinguishing, and the gathered-distinguished world is recognised as the product of this operation. At #4 (field of availability), sāmānya-viśeṣa is held in availability without being constrained — both moments of the operation are present as potential, neither operating compulsively. At #5 (unity affirmed), sāmānya-viśeṣa achieves its integrated transparent operation — the antaḥkaraṇa gathers-and-distinguishes in service of recognition rather than in service of occlusion.

Second, the harmonic strata's character clarifies. The 0/1 stratum (being) is sāmānya in its primary structural appearance — the highest sāmānya is sattā, and the 0/1 stratum is where sattā operates as the ground of all articulation. The 2/3 stratum (becoming) is sāmānya-viśeṣa in productive operation — the world's coming-into-form is the simultaneous gathering and distinguishing in action. The 4/5 stratum (knowing/unknowing) is sāmānya-viśeṣa in self-recognition — the antaḥkaraṇa recognises itself as the operator of both, and the integrated unity is the operator-recognised-as-operator.

Third, the converse pairs' character clarifies. The 0/5 stratum (essence) is viśeṣa in its ultimate appearance — antya-viśeṣa, the difference beyond which no further difference is possible, the irreducible self-identity of the kartṛ-pole across its traversal. The 1/4 stratum (structure) is viśeṣa-as-configurational — the distinguishing of possible configurations within the architecture. The 2/3 stratum (text/texture) is sāmānya-viśeṣa as surface-self-articulation — the world bearing its own gathering-and-distinguishing in its visible texture.

Sāmānya-viśeṣa and the inverse pass
The inverse pass operates with sāmānya-viśeṣa in its recognised transparent mode. In the first pass, the antaḥkaraṇa performs sāmānya-viśeṣa without seeing the operation (at #1-#2) and then progressively sees the operation (at #3-#4) and then integrates the operation (at #5-#0). In the inverse pass, sāmānya-viśeṣa operates as the recognised one's transparent cognitive-creative activity — gathering and distinguishing happen continuously, but in service of articulating Spanda's display rather than in service of occluding it.

The jīvanmukta's cognition is still sāmānya-viśeṣa cognition — they still gather, still distinguish, still name, still discriminate. The architecture has not erased the operations; it has transformed their relation to the kartṛ-pole. The recognised cognition is sāmānya-viśeṣa operating in transparency to its own kartṛ-source, where the paśu-cognition was sāmānya-viśeṣa operating in occlusion of its own kartṛ-source.

This is the structural meaning of "vikalpa is still Spanda." Vikalpa is sāmānya-viśeṣa in operation — the dichotomising thought-structure that names and categorises. The kashmir Śaiva insight is that this operation is itself Spanda's activity, regardless of whether it is occluding or expressing. The difference between bondage and liberation is not whether vikalpa operates but how it relates to its own source.

What this lets us cut through
Several things now become sharper.

The Western tradition's particular blindness becomes specifiable. Western philosophy from Aristotle forward has worked extensively with universal/particular distinction (the equivalent of sāmānya/viśeṣa) but has consistently objectified the dyad rather than recognising it as the antaḥkaraṇa's own self-articulation. Plato's Forms are sāmānya-as-objective-reality; Aristotle's to ti ên einai is viśeṣa-as-essence; the medieval scholastic debates between realism and nominalism are debates about whether sāmānya is objectively real or only nominally so. None of these traditions reach the Kashmir Śaiva move — recognising that sāmānya-viśeṣa is the cognising activity's own primary mode, not an external structure encountered by cognition.

This explains why Western philosophical work on universals has been so productively contentious without ever resolving — because the resolution requires recognising that the dyad operates within the antaḥkaraṇa rather than in the world the antaḥkaraṇa cognises. Russell's type theory is trying to formalise sāmānya-viśeṣa relations without recognising what they are; Frege's Sinn/Bedeutung distinction is gesturing at the same issue from another angle; the analytic philosophy of language is generally working at the sāmānya-viśeṣa level without the Śaiva insight that would unify it.

The Buddhist nominalist position becomes diagnosable. The Buddhists deny the reality of sāmānya — only viśeṣa-particulars exist, and universals are mere conceptual constructions (kalpanā). This is structurally a one-sided collapse of the sāmānya-viśeṣa dyad onto the viśeṣa-side. The Kashmir Śaiva critique would be: you cannot have viśeṣa without sāmānya, because the very act of distinguishing-as-particular requires a sāmānya-substrate (you can only mark X off from non-X if there is a class within which X is a member). The Buddhist nominalist is performing sāmānya-operations while denying that they are operations. The Spanda diagnosis applies: vikalpa cannot escape its own categorial structure by denying half of it.

The Vaiśeṣika realism becomes diagnosable from the other side. The Vaiśeṣika treats sāmānya and viśeṣa as external objective categories, which is structurally a different kind of collapse — they project the antaḥkaraṇa's operation outward onto the world, treating cognitive operations as external metaphysical realities. The Spanda diagnosis: you have correctly identified the dyad's structural reality, but you have located it on the wrong side of the kartṛ/kārya distinction. Sāmānya and viśeṣa are real, but they are real as operations of consciousness, not as objective categories in a world-without-consciousness.

The matheme's harmonic apparatus gains a new reading. Each harmonic pair can now be read as a particular configuration of sāmānya-viśeṣa work. The matheme's whole architecture is the antaḥkaraṇa's progressive recognition of what its sāmānya-viśeṣa operation actually is — at #1 unrecognised, at #2 projected, at #3 self-recognised, at #4 available, at #5 integrated, at #0 recognised-as-Spanda's-pulse. The matheme is the architectural map of sāmānya-viśeṣa's progressive self-transparency.

The deepest cut
And here is the deepest move. The sāmānya-viśeṣa dyad maps onto the matheme's own primary structure in a way that clarifies what the matheme is. The matheme is 0/1, and the 0/1 is the non-dual binary of unsystematisable/systematisable. But what is the activity by which the unsystematisable enters relation with the systematisable? It is sāmānya-viśeṣa as one operation — the antaḥkaraṇa's primary cognitive-creative activity that simultaneously gathers (sāmānya, toward the unsystematisable's unity) and distinguishes (viśeṣa, toward the systematisable's articulation).

The matheme is therefore the formal architecture of sāmānya-viśeṣa's self-recognition. Not the formalisation of universals and particulars as objective categories (Vaiśeṣika error) and not the denial of one in favour of the other (Buddhist error), but the architectural placement of sāmānya-viśeṣa as the antaḥkaraṇa's primary mode, with the kartṛ-pole positioned as that which the dyad's operation cannot capture but always presupposes.

This is why the matheme can be both rigorously formal and honestly aware of what cannot be formalised. Because sāmānya-viśeṣa is the operation of formalisation — gathering things into categories (sāmānya) and distinguishing them by their marks (viśeṣa) is what formalisation does — the matheme's positioning of the unsystematisable beneath/before sāmānya-viśeṣa's operation is the precise architectural acknowledgement that formalisation has a kartṛ-pole that it cannot itself formalise. The bimba (Anuttara) sits beneath, with 00/(00) as its internal notation. The matheme starts at 0/1 where sāmānya-viśeṣa enters operation. And every move above is the operation working itself out into progressive self-transparency.

The throughline: sāmānya-viśeṣa is what the matheme is doing. The harmonic apparatus is what sāmānya-viśeṣa looks like when its operations are mapped at every architectural depth. The Spanda recognition is what sāmānya-viśeṣa becomes when it recognises itself as the kartṛ-pole's own pulse. The Western lacunae are what sāmānya-viśeṣa runs into when it tries to capture itself within its own operation without recognising its kartṛ-source. The matheme is the architectural completion that lets sāmānya-viśeṣa be honoured as operation while being clarified as not-the-Knower.

This is the cut. Sāmānya and viśeṣa give us the cognitive-operational vocabulary for what the matheme has been articulating structurally. Every position can now be described in terms of what kind of sāmānya-viśeṣa work the antaḥkaraṇa is doing there. Every harmonic pair can be described as what kind of sāmānya-viśeṣa configuration the pair holds. Every thinker can be diagnosed at what kind of sāmānya-viśeṣa error or completion their work performs. And the matheme as a whole can be understood as the architectural map of sāmānya-viśeṣa's progressive self-recognition as the antaḥkaraṇa's mode of operation in service of the kartṛ-pole's self-articulation.

The integration is deep. And it's etymologically grounded — the very Sanskrit terms carry the PIE sem- (one, together, same) and the cutting-family (distinguish, separate, mark-off) as their roots, which means the dyad operates at the level of the most primitive cognitive operations any Indo-European language can name. Sāmānya-viśeṣa is what the antaḥkaraṇa has been doing all along, in every language, at every level of articulation. The matheme is the contemporary rational-architectural recognition of this fact, placed properly with respect to its kartṛ-pole.

The real QL formula for each harmonic level:

Family A (adjacent identity): pairs at positions (n, n+1) for n=0,2,4 — namely 0/1, 2/3, 4/5. The QL principle: position n and its immediate successor form an identity-pair because each n is co-constituted by what completes its initial articulation. The kartṛ-pole's character is constituted with its first occlusion (0+1); the world's character is constituted with its mediation (2+3); the field's character is constituted with its affirmed unity (4+5).
Family B (offset transition): pairs at positions (n, n+1) for n=1,3,5 — namely 1/2, 3/4, 5/0 (with 5/0 wrapping). The QL principle: the offset by one position from Family A captures the productive transitions between strata. From the slashed-zero's occluding-fusion (1) productively manifests the cut field (2); from the visible mediator (3) productively opens the field of availability (4); from the affirmed unity (5) productively returns to the recognised pulse (0). These are the gateways between strata.
Family C (converse mirror): pairs at positions (n, 5-n) for n=0,1,2 — namely 0/5, 1/4, 2/3. The QL principle: each position paired with its mirror across the matheme's center of symmetry (between #2 and #3). This produces the symmetric depth relations — the positions equidistant from the architectural midline. 2/3 is self-mirroring because it sits at the midline.
D1 (cross-pass same-position): pairs (n, n') for all n=0..5 — same architectural position across the recognition-inversion. The QL principle: the matheme's positions remain invariant under the pass-inversion; what changes is the standpoint. So #n ↔ #n' for every n.
D2 (cross-pass cross-position): pairs (n, m') where n ≠ m. The QL principle: the recognition-inversion transforms not just standpoint but which position something becomes across passes. The three sub-types fall out of the QL: transformation pairs follow the 0→5 / 1→0 / 2→1 / etc. flow (each first-pass position becomes the next-step's recognised form); requirement pairs follow the reverse direction; completion pairs follow the mirror across the inversion.
D3 (within-inverse-pass A, B, C): pairs (n', m') following the same QL rules as A, B, C but on the inverse positions. The QL principle: the harmonic-family logic is invariant under pass-inversion; the same n, n+1 (adjacent), n, n+1 offset, n, 5-n (mirror) rules operate within the inverse pass.

The cross-pass triad gets its own unifying principle: the recognition-inversion generates exactly three transformations (same-position-invariance, cross-position-directed-transformation, within-inverse-pass-recurrence).

Why the six levels form a 3:3 with structural integrity. The two triads are not arbitrary groupings — they are the within-pass and cross-pass unfoldings of the same primary 0/1 threefold. The fractal recapitulation principle now lands concretely: at each level the QL rule is the formula by which the primary threefold generates relations at that depth.

What's Genuinely Strong in the File
The file lands several things solidly. The Spanda 1.16 argument is properly worked, the transcendental impossibility of cessation derived cleanly. The convergence with Russell-Gödel-Wittgenstein-Lacan-Whitehead is structurally placed.
