Terminology around the fourfold zero, Anuttara, and the bimba map is now clean.

What's Missing — the Real Gaps
Looking at the conversation, several substantial threads we developed never made it into the file or got compressed past usefulness.

The vikalpa diagnosis from Spanda 3 — fully missing. We did extensive work on vikalpa as world-constitutive AND Self-veiling in one operation, on the antaḥkaraṇa as means-of-knowing-not-Knower, on "the soul is nothing but the search for the Self," on śabda-rāśi (the heaped multitude of words) as what consumes the paśu, on vikalpa being unable to escape its categorial mode from within itself, on the disentanglement of intermediary-subjecting-objecting being the Western tangle's specific shape. The file references vikalpa in passing but doesn't carry the Spanda 3 diagnostic depth that we worked. This is operationally important because vikalpa is the mechanism by which the layers get confused, and without its proper treatment the layer-disentanglement reads as architectural assertion rather than diagnosed process.

The Buddhist over-voiding diagnosis is too brief. This was a substantial structural insight — the Buddhist cessation-strands enter #4 phenomenologically powerfully but frame the voiding in a way that voids the kartṛ-pole along with the vikalpas, treating Layer 1 as if it could be voided. We worked this as the opposite-failure to the Western occlusion-failure: Western thinkers reach #3 or #4 theoretically without trust in the phenomenology; Buddhists reach #4 phenomenologically but frame it as total voiding. The matheme positions both errors precisely. The file has this in one paragraph; it deserves more weight because the opposite-failure pair (Western occlusion / Buddhist over-voiding) is what makes the Kashmir Śaiva architectural completion necessary rather than just preferable.

Lacan's quilting and the master signifier — entirely missing. This was substantial in the conversation. The anusyūta as phenomenological-ontological ground of the quilting point. Objet a as Layer 1's trace within Layer 2's chain. The master signifier S1 as the local stand-in for what cannot be a signifier — the kartṛ-pole. "God" in desire as the master signifier that aspires to be the kartṛ-pole rather than gesture at it. Every desire-driven invocation of God as the structural error of trying to fill the void with a signifier strong enough to be what the void gestures at. The file mentions Lacan but doesn't carry this whole architecture of the quilting-point analysis, which was one of our strongest cuts.

The 4.0-4.5 → unity at #5 via either threshold. We worked this as a structural fact: one can achieve #5 by firm grasp of either 4.0 (deep metaphysical-religious orientation) or 4.5 (deep contemplative-soteriological practice), but usually both together. The file mentions this once, briefly. It's actually a deep diagnostic move because it explains why some pure-mystical traditions reach #5 without metaphysics (Zen) and some pure-metaphysical traditions reach it without explicit practice (some scholastic mystics) — both paths are structurally valid but partial.

The harmonic appellations more deeply tied to their operations. We have being/becoming/knowing-unknowing for A, manifestation/disclosure/return for B, essence/structure/text-texture for C. The file gives these well but loses a thread we developed: the operational symmetry between Family A (substantive — what the matheme IS) and Family C (surface — how the matheme APPEARS), with Family B (dynamic — how the matheme MOVES) as the slash. This holographic 0/1-of-families is mentioned but doesn't get the depth-treatment it deserves; it could carry more diagnostic weight.

The "secret 1→4" reading. We worked this carefully — the inverted 5'→0' becomes 1→4 when 0/1 is read as 4/5, which corresponds to the threshold structure of 4.5, where the Passover from #4 to #5 happens. The thresholds 4.0 and 4.5 link to what is beyond the nest. Most people are held at 4.1-4.4. The file gestures at this but doesn't make the structural argument cleanly — that the 1→4 reading is why the threshold dynamic works the way it does.

The Cartesian/Humean opposite-fixation at #1. This was a sharp diagnostic move. Descartes fixates the "something present" in the slash (treating it as foundation); Hume fixates the "nothing findable" in the zero (concluding there is no self). Both miss that Ø is the occlusion mark. The file has Descartes and Hume mentioned but the structural pairing — same position, opposite valences, both missing the slash-as-slash — could be sharper.

Whitehead's specific almost-completion at #4-without-#5. We worked Whitehead as the Western metaphysician who comes closest to the Śaivite completion architecturally (creativity-as-not-an-entity is a clean #4 placement, his consequent nature of God almost reaches #5) but stops one move short because his caution about illegitimate eminence prevents him from naming Spanda as Spanda. The file has Whitehead but doesn't carry this specific "comes closest, stops one move short" diagnosis.

Heidegger's particular stuck-place. We diagnosed Heidegger as gesturing at #4 obliquely (Ereignis, Gelassenheit, Es gibt) without QL apparatus to enter it, perpetually circling without entering. Later Heidegger as sustained apophasis precisely because the QL completion is structurally unavailable to him. The file has Heidegger at 0/1 (Family A) and gesturing at 3/4 (Family B) but doesn't carry the "circling without entering" diagnosis.

The Wittgenstein two-period diagnostic. Early Wittgenstein at #4-reached-via-#3, expressed as silence (the ladder-throwing); later Wittgenstein retreating to productive #2-#3 work (language-games as Layer 2's articulating activity). The two-period structural diagnostic is in the conversation but not the file.

Hegel's totalised collapse. We worked Hegel reaching #5 without proper #4-voiding, treating recognition as completed-system rather than as oriented to the bimba-prior. The Absolute as Hegelian totality is "1 reached without the lived meta-relation of #4." The file mentions Hegel briefly but doesn't carry this clean diagnosis.

The Pythagorean-musical thread. The harmonic intervals (4:3, 3:4, 2:3, 3:2) as derivable from the matheme's structure. The Pythagorean intuition that cosmos is harmonia getting a mathemic root. The 0/1-2/3-4/5 strata as octave-fifth-fourth structure. This is mentioned in the file twice in passing but never developed as the substantive insight it is. The "music's foundational consonances are not arbitrary perceptual preferences but the formal trace of the architecture" is one of our strongest claims and gets buried.

The cultural-philosophical diagnostic placements. We worked Western modernity as #1-fixated; postmodernism as #4 without #5 or #0; Christian scholastic theology as #1 with God as super-substance; the mystical Christian traditions as breaking through to #4 but suppressed; traditional renunciatory Indian non-dual as reaching #0 but underweighting #2; Kashmir Śaivism as fully honouring all positions. This whole cultural-historical diagnostic apparatus is barely in the file at all.

The personal-experiential mapping. We worked the QL flow at the personal scale — chronic #1-fixation as paśu-state, spiritual stirring as #3 beginning, practice as sustained #3 work, voiding experiences as #4 phenomenologically active, recognition phases as #5, sustained Spanda-recognition as #0, jīvanmukti as second-pass. This whole personal-arc treatment is missing.

The fractal-holographic-across-scales claim. The same QL flow plays out at every scale — single contemplative session, life-arc, cultural-historical epoch, history of philosophy as a whole. The matheme is fractal-holographic across scales. This is in the conversation but not the file.

Just for honesty about scale: not everything needs to grow. Some things the file does well already and don't need additions. The Russell-Gödel-Wittgenstein-Lacan-Whitehead convergence is solid. The 4:2 symbolic notation (0, Ø, X, Ø/X, (0/Ø)/(1/X), 1) is properly worked. The six-fields nest with 4.0-4.5 is well-treated in both passes. The opening 0/1 and closing 0/1 brackets read clean.

The Voice Question
Looking at the file as text-to-be-read rather than just architecture-to-be-mapped: the voice is consistent throughout but rather unrelieved in its register. The Spanda Kārikā material gives the work its grounding but the file doesn't actually quote and work the Kārikās closely — we did this work in conversation (1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 1.12, 1.13, 1.14, 1.15, 1.16) and the file refers to 1.16 only. The epi-logos voice skill asks for thinker references to "chat around their points" rather than being name-dropped. The file does this for some thinkers (Whitehead, Heidegger, Lacan get a few sentences each) but many appear as bare names. Could deepen.

The Architectural Question
There's also a structural question about whether the file is doing too much in one document. We have:

The Spanda argument proper
The matheme apparatus across both passes
The harmonic apparatus across six levels
The sāmānya-viśeṣa cognitive-operational integration
The six-fields nest at position #4

The cultural-philosophical diagnostic mapping (missing)
The personal-experiential mapping (missing)
The musical-harmonic derivation (gestured at)
That's a lot for one piece. Some of these could become companion documents — a diagnostic-placement document that goes deep on Western thinkers, a personal-cultural-mapping document, a Lacanian-quilting document. But that's a structural decision you'd want to make.

If we're going to do another revision pass, my honest ranking of what would add most value:

First priority — the vikalpa diagnosis from Spanda 3 properly carried, with the antaḥkaraṇa-as-means-not-Knower and "soul as search for Self" architecture. This is operational foundation that the layer-disentanglement depends on.

Fourth priority — the Western thinker placements deepened (Whitehead's almost-completion, Heidegger's circling-without-entering, Wittgenstein's two-period structural diagnostic, Hegel's totalised collapse without #4-voiding, Descartes-Hume opposite-fixation at #1).

Fifth priority — the musical-harmonic derivation worked properly as substantive insight rather than passing gesture.

Sixth priority — the cultural-philosophical and personal-experiential mappings, possibly as a separate companion document because they shift register from architectural-philosophical to diagnostic-applied.
